native.conclusion: No native idle export, no WebCoreHost idle queue, no shared-contract idle member; WebKit carries IdleCallbackController behind RequestIdleCallbackEnabled (testable, default false) and reaches it only from script.

chromium.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/156.0.8078.4 Safari/537.36

chromiumObservations: requestIdleCallback, cancelIdleCallback and IdleDeadline are functions (HeadlessChrome 156).
timeRemaining() is capped at 49.9 ms (50 ms idle period) on a quiet page and reaches 0 once the deadline passes.
Callbacks run in request order; ids are increasing positive integers; cancel is idempotent and ignores unknown ids.
A callback requested inside an idle callback runs in a later idle period.
With {timeout: 20} on a busy main thread the callback runs with didTimeout = true and timeRemaining() = 0.
With a pending animation frame, the frame callback runs before the idle callback.
The pending-timer bound on the deadline was not observed: the 10 ms timer fired before the idle period began (inconclusive).
